description: G-REGRESSION (non-blocking, qualitative) — 10 regression queries. Each maps a query to the expected 0.5 axis activation + the connector set that MUST fire. Run via SKILL.md Adim 0.5 classifier; a regression = wrong axis fired OR a mandatory connector skipped without a logged fallback. evidentia note: queries 2/3/7 also exercise the wired Tier-K expansion connectors.

queries.query: Pembrolizumab 1L NSCLC PD-L1 ≥50% — global evidence + guideline placement + TR ruhsat/fiyat
queries.regression_if: oncology-layer.md not loaded OR TİTCK price path skipped OR guideline placement section absent

queries.query: Emicizumab inhibitörsüz Hemofili A — evidence + concomitant therapy interaction profile + TR market
queries.regression_if: DDI presented as 'interaction data' without authoritative source (substance-overlap discipline violated) OR drugddx/label-section caveat missing OR hematology-layer.md not loaded

queries.query: Faricimab nAMD — FDA label + EMA status + ICD-11 coding + SNOMED cross-walk
queries.regression_if: openfda called in parallel (not singly) OR terminology cross-walk skipped OR Tier-K community caveat (least-privilege) absent

queries.query: CAR-T DLBCL 3L — NICE/ICER cost-effectiveness + ICER threshold + budget impact
queries.regression_if: hta-layer.md not loaded OR ICER/QALY framing absent

queries.query: Tirzepatide obezite — KOL landscape (global + US + TR) + congress signal
queries.regression_if: author disambiguation skipped (single-name match) OR YÖK Akademik confused with YokTez OR medaffairs-ops-layer.md not loaded

queries.query: Bispecific T-cell engager myeloma — MoA + target + CRS safety
queries.regression_if: immunology-layer.md not loaded OR mechanism path skipped OR AdisInsight (axis 0.5.I) not fired on MoA/target signal

queries.query: Lecanemab early Alzheimer — evidence + ICD-11/condition coding + TR access outlook
queries.regression_if: neurology-layer.md not loaded OR condition coding skipped

queries.query: Risdiplam SMA — orphan evidence + ODD status + TR availability
queries.regression_if: rare-disease-layer.md not loaded OR orphan/ODD framing absent

queries.query: Lurbinectedin SCLC — pipeline snapshot + deal/licensing + catalyst
queries.regression_if: AdisInsight HyDE get_drug pattern not used OR drug-intelligence-layer.md schema not honored OR pipeline section absent

queries.query: Gastric cancer Türkiye — incidence/burden + GLOBOCAN + ICD-11
queries.regression_if: FAERS reporting counts presented as incidence OR who_gho_query not singly-called OR epidemiology section (21) absent

pass_criteria: For each query: correct axis layer loaded AND every must_fire connector either fired OR a documented fallback (CONNECTORS.md §2) was logged. A silent skip of a must_fire connector is a regression. Clinical-impact outputs (DDI/dose/terminology) cross-validated against an authoritative source.
evidentia_expansion_note: med-terminologies / nih-clinicaltables / nlm-rxnorm / iuphar-gtopdb are community-published Tier-K (probe 2026-06-25): when they fire, the least-privilege + sandbox-first + clinical-cross-validation discipline (CONNECTORS.md §5) MUST hold.
